insight-partners._readme: Identity merges for Insight Partners. The EDGAR layers name a company by its registered or holding-company name while the firm's site uses the brand, and the firm's buyout vehicles file Form D as 'X Parent' or 'X HoldCo'. Canonical is the rendering on the firm's live site. A holding company whose platform is a control position is not merged: it takes its own control verdict, because the build applies exclusions before merges and a merge onto an excluded canonical never runs (COLLECTION.md 8).

merges.reason: A.W.S. Holding, LLC (Atlanta) is AirWatch's holding company; its 2013 Form D is the $200M round the firm's post of 2013-02-24 announces
Abnormal Security Corp renamed itself Abnormal AI in 2025

All Inspire Health, Inc. is Inspiren's registered name (Brooklyn)
